targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(convert_distance((distance_m / 1609.344))::numeric, 1) AS "🛣️ Distance",
  ROUND((duration_s / 60.0)::numeric) AS "⏱️ Duration (min)",
  ROUND(convert_speed((max_speed_mps * 2.2369362920544))::numeric) AS "🏎️ Max Speed",
  start_soc_pct AS "🔋 Start %",
  end_soc_pct AS "🔋 End %",
  ROUND(convert_temp(ambient_temp_c_avg)::numeric, 1) AS "🌡️ Temp"
FROM drives WHERE id = ${drive_id}

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(p.ts, '10s') AS time,
  last(p.lat, p.ts) AS latitude,
  last(p.lng, p.ts) AS longitude,
  convert_speed_mps(last(dt.speed_mps, p.ts)) AS speed,
  last(bl.battery_level, p.ts) AS battery_level
FROM positions p
JOIN drives d ON d.vehicle_id = p.vehicle_id
  AND p.ts BETWEEN d.started_at AND COALESCE(d.ended_at, NOW())
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sample.speed_mps
  FROM drive_telemetry sample
  WHERE sample.vehicle_id = p.vehicle_id
    AND sample.ts BETWEEN d.started_at AND p.ts
    AND sample.speed_mps IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY sample.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
) dt ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT COALESCE(sample.float_value, sample.int_value::float8) AS battery_level
  FROM signal_log sample
  WHERE sample.vehicle_id = p.vehicle_id
    AND sample.field = 'BatteryLevel'
    AND sample.ts BETWEEN d.started_at AND p.ts
  ORDER BY sample.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
) bl ON TRUE
WHERE d.id = ${drive_id}
  AND p.ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(dt.ts, '30s') AS time,
  convert_speed_mps(MAX(dt.speed_mps)) AS "Speed"
FROM drive_telemetry dt
JOIN drives d ON d.vehicle_id = dt.vehicle_id
  AND dt.ts BETWEEN d.started_at AND COALESCE(d.ended_at, NOW())
WHERE d.id = ${drive_id}
  AND dt.ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND dt.speed_mps IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(sl.ts, '30s') AS time,
  MAX(COALESCE(sl.float_value, sl.int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE sl.field = 'BatteryLevel') AS "🔋 Battery %"
FROM signal_log sl
JOIN drives d ON d.vehicle_id = sl.vehicle_id
  AND sl.ts BETWEEN d.started_at AND COALESCE(d.ended_at, NOW())
WHERE d.id = ${drive_id}
  AND sl.ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND sl.field IN ('BatteryLevel')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(cs.ts, '30s') AS time,
  convert_temp(MAX(cs.inside_temp_c)) AS "Cabin",
  convert_temp(MAX(cs.outside_temp_c)) AS "Outside"
FROM climate_snapshots cs
JOIN drives d ON d.vehicle_id = cs.vehicle_id
  AND cs.ts BETWEEN d.started_at AND COALESCE(d.ended_at, NOW())
WHERE d.id = ${drive_id}
  AND cs.ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND (cs.inside_temp_c IS NOT NULL OR cs.outside_temp_c IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH samples AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(ms.ts, '30s') AS time,
    MAX(ms.front_torque_nm) AS torque_nm,
    NULL::double precision AS speed_mps
  FROM motor_snapshots ms
  JOIN drives d ON d.vehicle_id = ms.vehicle_id
    AND ms.ts BETWEEN d.started_at AND COALESCE(d.ended_at, NOW())
  WHERE d.id = ${drive_id}
    AND ms.ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND ms.front_torque_nm IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(dt.ts, '30s') AS time,
    NULL::double precision AS torque_nm,
    MAX(dt.speed_mps) AS speed_mps
  FROM drive_telemetry dt
  JOIN drives d ON d.vehicle_id = dt.vehicle_id
    AND dt.ts BETWEEN d.started_at AND COALESCE(d.ended_at, NOW())
  WHERE d.id = ${drive_id}
    AND dt.ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND dt.speed_mps IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  time,
  MAX(torque_nm) AS "Torque (Nm)",
  convert_speed_mps(MAX(speed_mps)) AS "Speed"
FROM samples
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

list.definition: SELECT d.id AS __value, CONCAT(COALESCE(v.display_name, 'Vehicle'), ' — ', TO_CHAR(d.started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' — ', COALESCE(d.start_place, 'Unknown'), ' → ', COALESCE(d.end_place, 'Unknown')) AS __text FROM drives d JOIN vehicles v ON v.id = d.vehicle_id UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS __value, 'No drives' AS __text WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM drives) ORDER BY __value DESC LIMIT 200
